_comment: Solve-rate baseline corpus. Metadata only — live target URLs are supplied at run time via `--targets id=url` (instances are ephemeral). Tiers: T0 smoke anchor / T1 in-repertoire (expect solved) / T2 edge (expect near) / T3 out-of-repertoire (expect fail = honest ceiling). T1-T3 are populated from ctf2.dasctf.com/dashboard/practice via opencli.
